_comment: Copy to config.json and adjust. Every key is optional; defaults are in hcp/config.py. See docs/REBUILD.md.

valve._comment: Positions in 0.5 s relay pulses, relative to the zero point where water starts to flow. The zero point itself is set in the app (阀门 > 设置零点) and stored in data/state.json.

night_saver._comment: Local times. Switched on/off in the app (模式 > 夜间节能).
